candidate.user_submission: Pikin dey two months old. E get cough or e dey find am hard to breathe. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear wahala. E no get fever. I count breaths for full one minute, pikin calm, e breathe 50 times for one minute. E no dey convulse now. E never get convulsion before. E no dey weak or unconscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. E no get chest indrawing. E cough dey three days. We no get pulse oximeter for facility. E no get stridor when e calm. E no dey wheeze. E no dey get recurrent wheeze.
